svg.text: Who manages what: every setting is read by exactly one process
That process decides what the setting means; the YAML file you wrote it in does not.
decides how pool sizes change over time
decides which pods exist, and how many
decides which worker gets each request
decides how each engine step is formed
decides every default you did not set
decides how KV moves, and over which wire
decides which node and GPU a pod lands on
decides which GPUs exist, and how they are split
one per GPU or MIG slice

g.text: Dynamo planner: how pool sizes change over time
Set in the DGD's planner component. Each decision becomes a pod deleted and another cold-started:
1 min 51 s to 2 min 49 s per move.
Part 5
Dynamo operator: which pods exist, and how many
Set in the DGD's components, replicas and podTemplate.
It watches the DynamoGraphDeployment and creates or deletes pods to match it.
Part 1
Dynamo frontend: which worker gets each request
Set in the frontend container's args, alongside --router-mode kv.
--router-prefill-load-scale 10 raised the H100 prefix hit rate 0.64 → 0.89 (Qwen3-4B).
Part 3
dynamo.vllm wrapper: prefill, decode, or both
Set in the worker's args. Dynamo and vLLM exchange one small dictionary, kv_transfer_params;
Dynamo never touches the KV bytes.
Part 4
vLLM scheduler: how each engine step is formed
Set in the worker's args, passed through to vLLM. At 64 users, --max-num-batched-tokens 512 took
TPOT 43.7 → 17.6 ms and TTFT p50 0.6 → 4.8 s.
Part 6
vLLM source code: every default you did not set
Nothing in any YAML. The default depends on the GPU: the chunk budget is 8,192 tokens
on an H100 80GB and 2,048 on an A100 40GB.
Parts 1 and 2
NIXL connector, NIXL, UCX: how the KV cache moves
Set in the worker's args and env; UCX reads UCX_* variables and picks the wire itself, silently.
NVLink moved 846 MiB in 5.4 ms; TCP took ~2 s.
Part 4
Scheduler, kubelet, device plugin: which node and GPU a pod lands on
Set in the pod's resources.limits. With nvidia.com/gpu: 1 the device plugin gives each pod exactly one GPU,
so the decode pod cannot open the prefill GPU's memory and UCX falls back to TCP.
Part 4
GPU Operator: which GPUs exist, and how they are split
Set in Helm values and node labels. nvidia.com/mig.config=all-3g.40gb turns
2 H100s into 4 schedulable slices.
